### 1. Technical Environment

* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso 1.16.11
* **code_version:** 369090fbce5900618b0bb78d8b261699f7b02c1e
* **Active Configs:** DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 (commit-workflow sentinel for hook_record_test_status_guard allowlist)
* **Context Scope:** Reporter repo `/Users/joeoakhart/parity-scan` on commit `a066f4da`, branch `main`. Artifacts dir resolved to `/tmp/workflow-plugin-44de6f24bdfdf40a/`.
* **Reporter context:** Host project using DSO as a plugin (host = parity-scan); reproducible failure during normal commit flow.

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

A second invocation of `record-test-status.sh --source-file <src>` against the same `diff_hash` — where every required test for that source is already present in the progress file — should write `test-gate-status` containing `tested_files=<comma-joined union of all completed tests>` and a fresh timestamp, regardless of any prior `tested_files` value at that path. In particular, it must never preserve `tested_files=doc-only-exempt` when concrete test paths are present in the progress file.

The downstream pre-commit test gate (`hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh:715-738`) reads `tested_files` from this status file to verify all required tests ran. A stale `doc-only-exempt` value causes the gate to report missing tests that were in fact run and recorded.

#### Actual Behavior

Two cooperating defects in `hooks/record-test-status.sh` allow `test-gate-status` to be silently downgraded to `tested_files=doc-only-exempt` and then frozen there, even though the progress file proves which tests have actually passed at the same `diff_hash`.

**Bug A — `doc-only-exempt` clobbers a richer same-hash record (record-test-status.sh:566-578).**

The "no associated tests" early-exit unconditionally writes `tested_files=doc-only-exempt` with `cat > "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/test-gate-status"` (truncate). It does not check whether the existing `test-gate-status` already contains a richer record at the same `diff_hash`. The original a2e0-3ae8 motivation (write `doc-only-exempt` so harvest-worktree.sh finds the file) is preserved as long as no richer record exists at the same hash; the unconditional clobber violates that invariant.

**Bug B — resume short-circuit does not reconcile `test-gate-status` (record-test-status.sh:611-623, 810-845, 847-862).**

When the resume path detects all required tests are present in `$_PROGRESS_FILE`, the per-test loop skips every iteration without re-writing `test-gate-status` with a fresh `tested_files` list. The merge-with-existing branch (line ~847) reads `_existing_tested=doc-only-exempt` and the merged result keeps that value as the dominant one — leaving the gate stuck with a record that contradicts the progress file.

The symptom in the field: a second invocation produced only the stderr line `Resuming: 6 tests already passed — skipping.` and never reached a status-write block that wrote the actual tested_files union from `_COMPLETED_TESTS`.

#### Net Effect (User-Visible)

The pre-commit test gate then blocks the commit:

```
BLOCKED: test gate — not all required tests were run.
Missing: src/app/lib/__tests__/apiKeys.test.ts
  Re-run: .claude/scripts/dso record-test-status.sh --source-file <changed-source-file>
```

— even though all required tests had been recorded in a prior invocation at the same `diff_hash`. The recommended re-run does not fix it (Bug B short-circuits) and the user has no documented escape path other than manually deleting `test-gate-status` and the matching `test-gate-progress-*` file before re-recording.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Initial pre-commit blocked because lint-staged auto-formatting changed diff_hash from `1c6a45fa27e9...` to `2fdc7ac636a1...`; gate reported no test status recorded for the new hash.
  * Step 1: `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 bash .../hooks/record-test-status.sh --source-file src/app/lib/data.ts` — full suite ran; `test-gate-status` correctly contained the comma-joined `tested_files` list (8 entries).
  * Step 2: `git commit` retried; lint-staged + pre-commit pipeline ran again and `test-gate-status` was silently overwritten to `tested_files=doc-only-exempt` at the same `diff_hash`. Bug A.
  * Step 3: `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 bash .../hooks/record-test-status.sh --source-file src/app/lib/data.ts` re-invoked; output was a single stderr line `Resuming: 6 tests already passed — skipping.`; `test-gate-status` still showed `tested_files=doc-only-exempt`. Bug B.
  * Step 4 (recovery): `rm -f /tmp/workflow-plugin-44de6f24bdfdf40a/test-gate-status /tmp/workflow-plugin-44de6f24bdfdf40a/test-gate-progress-*` then re-ran `record-test-status.sh`. Status file re-populated correctly. Commit advanced past the gate.
* **Raw Results:**
  * After Step 1, `test-gate-status` contained `tested_files=src/app/lib/__tests__/apiKeys.test.ts,src/app/lib/__tests__/data.fetch.test.ts,src/app/lib/__tests__/data.suggestions.test.ts,src/app/lib/__tests__/data.write.test.ts,src/app/lib/__tests__/projects.test.ts,src/app/lib/auth/__tests__/staleRole.test.ts,tests/architecture/auth-url-ecs.test.ts,tests/architecture/use-server-module-purity.test.ts`
  * After Step 2, `test-gate-status` contained `passed / diff_hash=2fdc7ac636a18ac2c75cfbc6ecca48318735a9506118e35b3dae7f31aff37911 / timestamp=2026-05-08T00:45:56Z / tested_files=doc-only-exempt`
  * After Step 3, the progress file at `/tmp/workflow-plugin-44de6f24bdfdf40a/test-gate-progress-2fdc7ac636a18ac2-7ff90171` listed 6 tests but `test-gate-status` was unchanged.
* **Known Workarounds:** Delete both `test-gate-status` and the matching `test-gate-progress-*` files, then re-invoke `record-test-status.sh`. This is undocumented and inefficient — it forces a full test-suite re-run because the progress file (which would otherwise enable resume) is also deleted.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** `/dso:commit` workflow → `record-test-status.sh` → `pre-commit-test-gate.sh`
* **Skills Invoked:** None directly; this is a hook-layer script invoked from the commit workflow.

### 7. Additional Details

#### Synthetic Reproduction Recipe

1. Stage two files: one source (`src/foo.ts`) with associated tests in `.test-index`, one purely doc/no-test (`docs/foo.md`).
2. `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 record-test-status.sh --source-file src/foo.ts` → rich record written.
3. `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 record-test-status.sh --source-file docs/foo.md` → doc-only-exempt path fires and clobbers (Bug A).
4. `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1 record-test-status.sh --source-file src/foo.ts` → `Resuming: N tests already passed — skipping.` and `test-gate-status` still says `tested_files=doc-only-exempt` (Bug B).
5. `git commit` is blocked despite all tests having passed.

#### File / Line References (dso 1.16.11)

* `hooks/record-test-status.sh:566-578` — doc-only-exempt write (Bug A)
* `hooks/record-test-status.sh:611-623` — resume detection
* `hooks/record-test-status.sh:810-845` — per-test loop with skip-completed branch
* `hooks/record-test-status.sh:847-862` — merge-with-existing branch (Bug B)
* `hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh:715-738` — gate that surfaces the symptom

#### Suggested Fix Direction (reporter's proposal)

Two complementary guards in `record-test-status.sh`:

1. **Bug A guard** at the doc-only-exempt write site (~line 566): refuse to downgrade an existing record at the same `diff_hash` whose `tested_files` is non-empty and not `doc-only-exempt`:

   ```bash
   if [[ -f "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/test-gate-status" ]]; then
       _existing_hash=$(grep '^diff_hash=' "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/test-gate-status" | cut -d= -f2)
       _existing_tested=$(grep '^tested_files=' "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/test-gate-status" | cut -d= -f2-)
       if [[ "$_existing_hash" == "$DIFF_HASH" ]] \
          && [[ -n "$_existing_tested" ]] \
          && [[ "$_existing_tested" != "doc-only-exempt" ]]; then
           exit 0   # already a richer record at this hash — do not downgrade
       fi
   fi
   ```

2. **Bug B guard** at the end-of-script status-write path: even when every test is a resume skip, always write `test-gate-status` with `tested_files=` populated from the union of `_COMPLETED_TESTS` ∪ `TESTED_FILES_LIST`, and never preserve `doc-only-exempt` as the merged value when concrete test paths are also present.
data.title: hooks/record-test-status.sh: re-invoke after doc-only-exempt clobber -> resume short-circuit leaves stale tested_files=doc-only-exempt; pre-commit gate blocks valid commits
